source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE after schema and typed value oracle are supplied.

old_problem: The exact OEM D-Bus object is named, but no authoritative interface/property/method/signal contract or current-value mapping defines `correct`; introspection metadata alone does not validate runtime BIOS values.
disposition_reason: Generic D-Bus documentation establishes read-only introspection/Get semantics but cannot define Wistron's OEM schema or BIOS-state values. ED-03 permits a draft, not guessed OEM parameters; the missing contract is the PASS/FAIL oracle, so Pending remains.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2248 and 2249, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical record and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve the literal service/object and separate schema validation from typed property-value validation.
Bind BMC/BIOS firmware, service owner/readiness and mandatory versus optional members before collection.
Allow only introspection and approved Get/GetAll operations; do not invoke methods, set properties or restart services.
Missing/incorrect signatures, access modes or values must be reported per member without guessing.
No BMC login, D-Bus query, method call, property set or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: OEM BIOS D-Bus schema and typed state validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the named BIOS OEM service/object exposes the approved versioned D-Bus contract and current typed values corresponding to the captured BIOS state.
required_package: Approved mandatory/optional interfaces, members, signatures and access modes
Expected property enumerations/values and BIOS-state mapping
Protected console credentials and redaction policy
test_case.test_command: On the verified BMC, run the literal verbose introspection, preserve stdout/stderr/exit, then use read-only Get/GetAll only for approved properties and structurally compare schema and typed values.
test_case.expected_result: The service owner is ready; every mandatory member has the approved signature/access; optionality matches the SKU; each readable property equals the approved current BIOS-state mapping.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed version-specific schema and per-property oracle plus complete matching evidence. Readable output alone cannot pass. Missing oracle retains Pending; wrong owner, member, signature, access or value is FAIL after the oracle exists.
safety_gate: Verified BMC/service/object and protected console only.
Introspection and Get/GetAll only; no method calls, sets or restarts.
Redact secrets without removing compared fields.
Stop on owner, activation, signature or permission ambiguity.
expected_evidence: Typed property outputs and BIOS-state mapping
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected; on service/schema ambiguity stop and preserve evidence without restarting or correcting the object.
